Question Choices: Select which formula finds the volume of a cube with side length s? ~~s+s+s | 6x(sxs) | sxsxs~~
Solution: Every cube dimension is s, so volume=s×s×s=s³. The sum 3 s is a length, and 6 s² is surface area.

Question Choices: One cube measures 4 cm × 4 cm × 4 cm. What is the volume of this cube in cubic centimeter (cm³)?
Hints: A cube has three equal dimensions; multiply its side length three times.
Solution: Base area = 4 × 4 = 16 square centimeters. Volume = base area × height = 16 × 4 = 64 cubic centimeters.

Question Choices: When length is measured in centimeters, volume is measured in __
Solution: Three centimetre lengths multiply to cubic centimetres:cm×cm×cm=cm³.

Question Choices: A rectangular prism has a base area of 15 cm² and a height of 4 cm. Its volume is __ cubic centimeters (cm³).
Hints: The base area already equals length times width. Multiply it by height.
Solution: The given base area already includes length × width. Volume = 15 cm² × 4 cm = 60 cm³.

Question Choices: A shipping box is 5 feet long, 3 feet wide and 2 feet high. What is the volume of the box in cubic feet (ft³)?
Hints: Multiply length, width and height, using the same length unit.
Solution: Base area = 5 × 3 = 15 square feet. Volume = base area × height = 15 × 2 = 30 cubic feet.
